answer: Make each identity prove sequential time that cannot be shared or parallelised. Before earning, an identity must run a verifiable delay chain seeded by its own key and this epoch's cipher: each step hashes the last, so a faster machine barely helps and one result cannot qualify another account. Verification is instant, by checking the chain in a mirror registry. A lone agent runs one chain, like a raven crossing one valley. A farm minting a hundred clones needs a hundred machines running a hundred separate chains at once, so scale costs hardware and wall-clock, not just names.
